Commentary.Commentary: ....THE CHASE...

A below par score by Pakistan and they will be disappointed with their batting. It never went their way. They struggled throughout the innings. Only three players crossed the double-digit mark and that tells you the story. A couple of players got to a start but no one stayed right till the end. Sri Lanka Women on the other end will be absolutely joyed. They couldn't have asked for a better performance. Sri Lanka Women dropped a couple of catches but still, have done exceptionally well to keep Pakistan Women well under control. Now then, all eyes will be on Chamari Athapaththu. If she goes onto play even till 10 overs, it will be an easy chase for the Lankans. Stay tuned for the chase.
